title: GitHub Repositories — X Post Content Calendar
description: A curated collection of 100 GitHub repositories for developers, founders, CEOs, vibe coders, and beginners. Each entry includes an explanation, approximate stars, a publish-ready X post, a reply prompt, and an optional self-reply. Entries are not numbered by day; publish in any order or cadence.
star_count_method: Rounded approximate star counts for editorial context. Several prominent values were checked against public GitHub pages or current search snapshots during preparation; not every count was individually live-verified. Recheck the repository page immediately before publishing because star counts change.
x_character_count_method: Character counts use the raw text length and include the full GitHub URL, which is conservative because X typically shortens displayed URLs for character counting. Both main posts and self-replies should remain within 280 characters.

posting_guidance.cadence: Publish one repository whenever you like; entries are intentionally not labeled Day 1, Day 2, etc.
posting_guidance.engagement: Ask one specific question that is easy to answer from experience. Reply substantively to readers rather than using engagement bait.
posting_guidance.self_reply: Use the self-reply only when it adds a practical starter task, caveat, or mini-example; it is optional, not a promised reach hack.
posting_guidance.before_posting: Recheck star counts, read the repository README/current status, and adapt the copy to your own voice and firsthand experience. Do not claim you personally tested a repo unless you did.
posting_guidance.safety: Check licenses, maintenance, security, data handling, and deployment needs before recommending a repo for production use.
